statement: For an out-of-range guest EEPROM write, pinned rnconrad wiimote.c emits a queued memory read-result (input report 0x21) containing error code 8 (lines 299-307). For the equivalent valid-sized write, Dolphin instead emits a write ACK (input report 0x22) containing InvalidAddress (EmuSubroutines.cpp lines 280-283 and 321-322). The source-side implementations disagree about reply report type, even though they select the same error number; retail behavior is unresolved.

applicability.revision: Historical independent software emulators, not physical hardware revisions
applicability.scope: wiimote.c lines 299-307 queue a memory-error response; wm_reports.c lines 89-109 confirm that builder is report 0x21; Dolphin EmuSubroutines.cpp lines 280-283 and 321-322 send report 0x22 for valid-sized WriteData failures. wii-c5-memory-errors backlink must be added only after PR #16 merges.
